A raid on a home belived to contain drugs. Suspected drug traffickers are arrested at an airport; a body is found floating in a canal; and an officer discusses his relationship with a colleague.

Suspected drug traffickers are arrested at an airport; a body is found floating in a canal; and an officer discusses his relationship with a colleague.
Domestic problems, including a sibling brawl and a young mother who lives in a crack house with her child.
Deputy encounters drug dealers and users on the street. Deputy Canada is participating in an undercover prostitution sting. Sergeant Deak leads, "Trojan Horse Two," an undercover drug sting.

Sergeant Steve Canfield of the SWAT Team leads training exercises, and take down a drug addict selling a stolen vehicle. Deputy Linda Canada encounters prostitutes while patrolling. Deputy Mike Hoffman responds to calls involving an injured dog, a bomb threat, and a man with a gun.

Captain Ron Cacciatore leads the pre-Super Bowl prostitution sweeps and drug stings. Deputy Vicki Cutcliffe cares for a toddler, after the parents are arrested in a drug sting. Deputy Mike Hoffman's shift on Super Bowl Sunday.

Deputy Linda Canada counsels a frightened child, arrests a known prostitute, and attends a charity football game. Deputy Jim Fondo talks to a juvenile prostitute, and apprehends juvenile shoplifters. Deputy Chris Wagoner of the DUI Task Force stops a drunk driver, and responds to a hit-and-run crash involving a pedestrian.

Deputies Jim Fondo and Glenn Topping respond to domestic calls and encounter prostitutes. Deputy Mike Hoffman conducts a motor vehicle stop, responds to a house known for narcotics and prostitution. On the following night, Deputy Mike Hoffman responds to the same house to remove the children.

Over the course of a week, Deputy Jim Fondo tries to help mother-daughter prostitutes. Sergeant Robert Deak leads the Drug Task Force in serving a warrant on drug dealers. Deputy Chris Wagoner of the D.U.I. Task Force stops a drunk driver, and investigates fatal crashes involving drunk drivers. Deputy Baron Philipson stops a drunk driver.

Captain Ron Cacciatore leads an undercover operation in the surveillance, buys, and arrests of drug traffickers. Sergeant Nick Frey leads his deputies in a survival training exercise. Deputy Jim Fondo responds to a report of gunshots heard.

Deputy Mike Hoffman responds to a call of a choking infant, and a domestic violence call. Sergeant Dennis Gavalier of the Organized Crime Division leads an undercover drug operation in the surveillance of a drug traffickers in a Lincoln Town Car. Deputy Russ Budden observes a transvestite prostitute inside a man's car, and investigates a motor vehicle crash caused by a drunk driver.

Deputy Russ Budden investigates an assault, and responds to a domestic violence call. Sergeant Dennis Gavalier of the Organized Crime Division investigates an anonymous tip of drug trafficking inside a U-Haul trailer. In Little Havana, Officer Ralph Suarez of the Miami Police Department arrests an aluminum thief, responds to a motor vehicle crash, and arrests car thieves.

Detective Howard Rudolph goes undercover inside an RV for the Organized Crime Division's "Trojan Horse" sting, lead by Sergeant Robert Deak. Deputy Mike Hoffman responds to domestic dispute between two elderly sisters. Later, Deputy Hoffman responds to a homicide inside a residential trailer.

Deputy Russ Budden stops a car with a motorist for a traffic violation. Deputy Glen Topping investigates a hit-and-run crash between a pedestrian and an elderly driver. Detective Bob Faulkner of the Broward County Sheriff's Office's Organized Crime Division participates in escort service stings. Sergeant Diego Ochoa of the Miami Police Department investigates a homicide at a bar in Little Havana.

Mayor Davis is enraged when his Limousine gets stolen by Nightshade and Squeeky Kleen who are planning on converting it into Big Boss' own personal limousine look-a-like along with all of the other cars they stole. He demands Highway and Hardtop to get his limousine back....or else!

Portland, Oregon Ofc Harry Jackson checks out a prostitute. Sgt John Bunnell meets with arrest team and they serve a search warrant, and subject agrees to call for more drugs, and seller is arrested. That seller cooperates to get his supplier.

Multnomah County Sheriff Dpty John Blackman car chase. Sgt John Bunnell tests a drug-sniffing K-9. Dpty Lane Sawyer attempts a drug buy sting. Rex the K-9 finds more drugs. Sgt Loren Caddy attempts mouth to mouth resuscitation and CPR on a domestic violence call.
Ofc Harry Jackson in roll call meeting, gang violence call two brothers beaten. Drug search warrant finds drugs, guns, no people. Car accident, drivers captured with K-9. Man with a gun apprehended.

Sgt Loren Caddy Ofc Lon Sweeny chase a guy with a sawed-off shotgun over fences. Dpty Jerry Hill talks with his CI helps Sgt John Bunnell take down a drug dealer. Dpty Mark Romanaggi serve arrest warrant.

Multnomah County Sheriff Sgt Loren Caddy is called in to perform an intoxilyzer test. Sgt John Bunnell arrests a grandmother drug dealer. Det Doug Ross leads team to a marijuana operation. Ofc Harry Jackson talks to three known prostitutes.

Sheriff John Duffy swears in new deputies. Helicopter fugitive search after subject hit by tazers runs away laughing. Dpty Bill Hubler rescues baby in locked car, investigates stolen VW work van. Sgt Derek Clark finds fighting woman stabbed in face.
Minneapolis partners Holly Keegal and Janee Harteau aid the sister of a drug and alcohol abuser; Officer Pam Melius comforts an elderly robbery victim.
The response to a sexual assault call on a minor; investigation of an apartment break-in, stalking. Domestic disturbance with man smoking crack.

Las Vegas Ofc Jack Clark scams a wanted criminal with a free TV. Ovc Mike Horn and K-9 Eich do routine training, then Ofc Eich sniffs out an offender. Bicycle mounted officer Sgt Debra Gauthier arrests felon.
Jersey City NJ Ofc Thomas Porter investigates shootings, man accused of threatening with a bat. Domestic call about a very young child.
Ofc Thomas Fletcher a prostitute pimped by her father who claims she is 17. Ofc Joseph Lombardo female vagrant who says the devil did it, tries to bite officer while claiming to be a vampire.
Houston Dpty Sieck shooting call at motel is airlifted by helicopter. Man with a Gun Call. Dpty Bubba Hinton investigates reported burglars breaking into cars and apartments.
In Kansas City, officers respond to a stabbing; a jealous man threatens his wife; a woman accidentally shoots her brother.
In Pittsburgh, a suspected drive-by-shooting plan is foiled during a drug sweep; a hit-and-run accident is investigated; a dispute between apartment tenants is mediated.

Boston Drug and search warrants served, and drug buyer sting in same apartment. Drug supplier arrested. Responding to woman in distress called in by woman's father. Disturbance call in a known drug house.

In Miami, Off. George Clinton assists in the capture of a suspected thief; Sgt. Steve Hammers leads a narcotics squad in a series of buy-bust operations; a shoplifting call finds the suspect in the custody of the shop owner.

In Miami, Off. Federico Chacon pursues a suspect by car and on foot; Officers Ron Shimka and Oldy Ochoa investigate an assault; drugs are seized in a bust by a narcotics unit of the Broward County Sheriff's Department.

Sheriff's deputies arrest a drunken-driving suspect; the police apprehend a man suspected of passing bad checks; a narcotics unit nabs two persons suspected of threatening an informant and his family.
Denver officers investigate a stabbing, a disturbance in a bar, and a hit-and-run, in which a suspect is arrested.

In Washington State, Dep. Bill Cassio investigates a shooting thought to be gang related; Off. Fred Doughty talks to an assault victim; Off. Tad Davis arrests an intoxicated man who had been seen carrying a shotgun.
In Washington state, deputy John Jiminez serves a warrant on an armed-robbery suspect; Dep. Shawn McDonald arrests a man for harassing a woman; and officer Fred Doughty responds to a woman's scream.
Seattle officer Tad Davis is called to the scene of an attempted suicide; Tacoma deputies respond to a holdup. Also: a man barricades himself in his home.
Phoenix officer Christopher Kawa arrests a burglary suspect, and guards a plane crash; Child wanders off from parents' Officer Matt Knowles checks out a man causing a disturbance at a motel.

The pursuit of a dangerous suspect along a busy Southern California freeway; a woman suspected of being intoxicated in public.
LA CA air unit Ofc Jorge Gonzalez assists officers overnight. Ofc Victor Klotz chases hit and run suspect. Ofc Rodney Peacock calms a domestic dispute.

Buffalo, NY backing up detective in burglary. Swat Team raid on alleged drug dealer. Investigate a dead body in a yard. Snake call in a yard.

Portland, OR Narcotics Task Force warrant execution and recover truckload of stolen valuables. Las Vegas, NV Narcotics Unit drug arrest, arrest and reverse drug buyer sting. Denver, CO drug sting.
In Miami, a tracking device leads to a suspected car thief; a driver ignores instructions to pull off the road; a woman is questioned about an alleged suicide by her boyfriend.

Miami-area police respond to a call about an auto break-in, and search for a man who allegedly assaulted an officer. Also: a K-9 unit is used to help apprehend a suspect who hid in deep foliage while trying to avoid capture.

An annual memorial service is held to commemorate the brave Miami Police Officers who risked their lives in the line of duty. A wanted fugitive may face some hard-time after authorities arrest him in connection to a residential burglary report in Miami, FL.
Officers discover cocaine during a routine traffic stop; an alleged gambling house is shut down; people who appear to be inebriated are questioned; a suspect takes a hostage.

Providence, R.I., officers stake out an area frequented by drug dealers. Also: Boston officers arrest a car-theft suspect; assist two women who claim a teenager stole their lawn furniture; and investigate an alleged auto theft.
A daring rooftop escape backfires on an elusive suspect. A driver is taken into custody after a stop sign related traffic stop. A man threatening self-harm reveals that he's trying to go to jail.
An officer responds to a back up call involving an uncooperative theft suspect. A reverse sting operation is conducted to bust deviant suspects. A possible alcohol induced car wreck is investigated.

An armed Florida father is arrested in connection to an attempted assault call and the child of the dysfunctional parents in question is placed in temporary child custody. A Southern Florida SWAT team suits up for a large scale drug raid, a myriad of evidence is recovered at the scene.
Shots are fired during a struggle with a knife-wielding suspect. A carjacking pursuit turns into a foot chase after the driver bails from the car. Evidence is recovered from an armed suspect.
A vehicular pursuit with a carjacking suspect turns into a foot chase and eventual arrest. Officers assist a struggling single mother with her unruly son. A freshly sprung ex-inmate is apprehended.

Officers pursue a driver who ran a stop sign; respond to a call about a rabid dog; and settle a dispute. Also: the investigation of an alleged domestic disturbance involving a man, his wife and his mother.

Alleged drug pushers are targeted in a sting; juveniles are stopped in a suspected stolen auto; a man is arrested for allegedly making threats against his ex-lover. Also: a report of a possible suicide is investigated.
Officers join the rescue operation after an airliner crash and investigate an auto accident involving an alleged drunken driver. Also: drug paraphernalia is found on a bicyclist.
Police intervene when a man threatens suicide. A stabbing suspect is arrested. A dispute between neighbors is settled. A paranoid woman makes a burglary call.

Boston officers arrest an alleged shoplifter; search for a missing 5-year-old; and look for the driver of an overturned truck. Also: a woman's claim that her father assaulted her is investigated; a dispute involving ownership of a bicycle is resolved.
In the Seattle area, deputies assist a man who claims he was assaulted; arrest a man allegedly in possession of a stolen car; and pursue a suspect wanted on outstanding warrants.

In the Seattle-Tacoma area, a woman claims she was assaulted by her ex-husband; a deputy covers a road with flares to stop a fleeing suspect; three neighboring families have a dispute over an abandoned boat.

In Seattle-Tacoma, a woman believed to be suicidal is impaled with a knife during an alleged struggle with officers; a robbery suspect hides in a wooded area; three children are attended to after their parents are arrested.

In Seattle-Tacoma, a deputy helps two citizens trying to detain an alleged hit-and-run driver; pepper spray is used on a domestic-dispute suspect; a woman reportedly strikes a man with an ax handle at a trailer park.

In Seattle-Tacoma, a K-9 unit helps catch a suspect who fled from a drug bust; phony police ID is found on a man alleged to have assaulted a woman at a motel; two Native American siblings request to be taken to a tribal jail.

A chase results when a vehicle refuses to pull over; a man is arrested for reportedly shoplifting lottery tickets from a convenience store; a woman claims her husband has violated a restraining order.

A Pierce County Deputy investigates a report of two suspicious men firing a shotgun in a field, at the scene it is learned that the men are farmhands who were hired to slaughter cows. A domestic violence call at a Pierce County residence is investigated, at the scene the suspect and victim are found in an upstairs bedroom together.
Woman eats and leaves without paying arrested on felony warrant. Report of rifle shots. Van stopped for report of man brandishing hand gun.
Seattle-Tacoma officers respond to a report of a man with a gun; pursue two suspects in a drug transaction; and question three suspects who claim their marijuana is for medicinal purposes.

Deputies in Fresno County utilize the help of the K-9 Unit to fish out an elusive suspect who had taken refuge in a plant nursery. A Fresno Deputy is flagged down by a group of people, they inform him that a near fatal altercation arose after a man's dog was accidentally hit. The suspect and gun that was brandished are located nearby.
Authorities work to detain an intoxicated and naked male suspect. Agents are airlifted to a remote marijuana grow operation. A car is searched as a result of a traffic stop and drugs are recovered.

A man forgets about the joint behind his ear on a traffic stop. An interpreter is called in to assist with the arrest during a domestic call. A driver is sent on his way after a flagrant traffic stop.
A male fugitive is found sleeping on a bus and gets a rude awakening. A domestic dispute involving a very pregnant woman is investigated. Two male suspects are misled in a transactional arrangement.
Shots fired call finds man on roof. 911 call domestic violence. Adult son threatens mother and her boyfriend.

EMT's save an infant with respiratory issues. Shoplifting suspects are arrested with the help of security footage. A buffet manager has a dispute with patrons over the definition of "all you can eat."

A distressed Pierce County mother and her husband work with a Deputy to find their runaway 14-year-old daughter, who is attempting to run away with an older male friend. A Pierce County mother abandons her young son in a car on the side of the road after her son bit her during an argument.
A report of an elderly ex-con firing off rounds in his home ends in arrest. Two youths are rescued from atop a water tower. A sexual solicitation incident turns into an attempted armed robbery.

Authorities inadvertently stumble upon a marijuana grow operation. An officer investigates an alcohol induced domestic call. A suspect claiming to be asking for directions is quickly busted for drugs.

A Fort Myers mental hospital escapee is located by authorites, but is combative and threatens self-harm when confronted by officers. A Lee County resident alerts authorities about a suspected bald eagle that's trapped in her chimney. A report of a DUI accident is investigated, the demonstrably drunk driver of the overturned truck flees the scene but is ultimately arrested.

A traffic stop is conducted to examine a vehicle's tags, the driver is placed in the back of the cruiser and shares a tearful goodbye with his daughter before being taken into custody. Back-up is called in a traffic stop involving two unruly men, one of which alleges that he needs medical attention and is carted off by EMTs.
An unruly driver is arrested after several warnings. Officers engage in a pursuit with a driver harboring an array of damning evidence.
In Las Vegas, a look at a casino's security system shows how customers attempt to cheat. Also: officers respond to a reported shooting involving children; and a domestic dispute.

In Las Vegas, an accidental family shooting is suspected of having been intentional; an alleged bicycle thief is caught in a sting; a driver is found to have a pistol, marijuana and an underage companion.

In Las Vegas, the police respond to calls reporting the beating of a woman with a bat, and a burglary in progress in which the suspect is revealed to be a family friend. Also: a night in a Las Vegas jail.
After being stopped following a vehicle chase, a suspected thief flees on foot. Also: officers respond to a reported battery at a convenience store, and to a man on a roof believed to be on drugs.

En route to a call involving burglary suspects, Las Vegas officers spot an alleged drug user. Also: a man is arrested for stealing bicycles from the police's impound facility; a suspect is caught with stolen credit cards.

A delirious woman becomes defensive when she's accused of bizarre behavior and begins fighting with officers in front of her kids. Grandma arrives and explains just how dire the situation has become. North Las Vegas officers assist a mother with her wayward daughter. The emotional teen argues that she can take care of herself on the streets.
Police pursue van-theft suspects; search the home of a man arrested for drug possession; question an alleged transvestite and two suspicious males.
In Las Vegas, officers snare alleged johns in a prostitution sting; a traffic-accident victim is assisted; a suspect is arrested for operating a car with a stolen license plate.

eps.t: Kansas City, Missouri; Kansas City, Kansas 17
eps.d: An officer chases a suspect who tries to escape after a traffic stop; officers encounter a pot-bellied pig while attempting to serve a warrant; a deputy checks the identity of a driver using someone else's car.
A man claims self-defense after reportedly stabbing another man during a robbery attempt; an apparent suicide is investigated; an officer sorts out a dispute between neighbors.

eps.t: Kansas City, Missouri; Kansas City, Kansas #18
eps.d: Officers respond to a shooting; sort out a landlord-tenant dispute stemming from alleged drug use; encounter a naked man sitting in the street.

A woman calls 911 screaming for help. Eagle-eyed officers spot her abusive boyfriend fleeing the scene. The battered woman admits she finds it hard to leave the situation despite the beatings. A bashful man hides behind a topless club with a woman he just picked up. The honest hooker admits she enjoys her work and was paid twenty dollars for her services tonight.
A burglary suspect is arrested after entering a detective's backyard; officers respond to a report of drug use in a park; a sting operation targets alleged johns.

A suspicious van is found to contain an alleged prostitute and customer; officers sort out a domestic dispute allegedly involving a man demanding to see his ex-girlfriend; a suspected unlicensed driver refuses to pull over.

eps.t: Kansas City, Missouri; Kansas City, Kansas 20
eps.d: Kansas City officers pursue an armed-robbery suspect and sort out a domestic dispute. Also: the pursuit of a suspect believed to be linked to a recent homicide.

A man drinking a beer on the sidewalk in North Las Vegas decides to resist arrest. The suspect proclaims his innocence even after officers locate multiple baggies of cocaine in his pockets. When officers respond to a shots fired call, they find a bloody man on the ground who claims he was beaten and thrown from a car. Officers recover equipment stolen from a convention in Las Vegas worth $60,000.
Officers investigate a woman's claim of a sexual assault on her daughter; and a report of vandalism by a woman's boyfriend. Also: a domestic dispute between two cousins.

A deputy assists when a traffic stop turns into a large drug bust, and later, the same officer is nearly hit by an alleged drunken driver; two suspects are caught when a train cuts off their escape route.
Footage of a motorcycle rally in South Dakota and coverage of police activities at the event.
Vice-squad officers pose as potential customers to target alleged prostitutes working on the street and for escort services; an officer pretends to be a prostitute to snare potential customers.
Officers question a man who claims his father abused him and respond to a domestic dispute. Also: the pursuit of a suspected drug addict who allegedly inhaled paint fumes.

eps.t: Kansas City, Missouri; Kansas City, Kansas 22
eps.d: Officers pursue a suspect allegedly driving at high speeds; and respond to a domestic dispute involving a man, his girlfriend and her mother, who claims he's abusive. Also: a man with a hot-water heater is questioned.

eps.t: Kansas City, Missouri; Kansas City, Kansas 23
eps.d: Officers respond to a shooting said to be in self-defense; an assault suspect is arrested; a young boy is accused of stealing a cigarette lighter.
Separate suspect searches reveal drug paraphernalia and a weapon; a domestic dispute involves a woman and her daughter.
From Houston, Texas. A shooting incident, a stabbing victim won't identify his attacker and deputies deal with a suicidal suspect.
Officers pursue an allegedly stolen moped; and question a skirt-wearing man believed to be exposing himself to passing motorists. Also: three men seen leaving a suspected crack house are interviewed.
Officers find marijuana after chasing a suspect; question two men in an area known for drug activity; stop a suspect who allegedly aimed a realistic-looking toy gun at someone.
A suspect flees after a traffic stop; a man accuses his wife of threatening him with a knife; a woman claims her boyfriend beat her while she was holding her young child.
Officers subdue a suspect alleged to have threatened his family; respond to a traffic accident in which a fellow officer was injured; sort out a domestic dispute involving an alleged crack addict.
Officers respond to a report of a pit bull killing another dog; and probe a domestic dispute allegedly caused by a wife's penchant for playing bingo. Also: a fleeing suspect is pursued.

eps.t: Kansas City, Missouri; Kansas City, Kansas 25
eps.d: Officers capture assault suspects; arrest an alleged carjacker; and question a trespassing suspect. Also: a domestic dispute involving a man and his teenage son.
Officers respond to an alleged hit-and-run; question two men involved in a traffic dispute; pull over a vehicle reported stolen; and mediate an argument between neighbors over a cat.
Officers investigate a report of someone breaking into vehicles; and sort out a domestic dispute. Also: an alleged prostitute is found hiding beneath a bed in a motel room.

eps.t: Kansas City, Missouri; Kansas City, Kansas 26
eps.d: Officers subdue a man with outstanding warrants; give chase after seeing a driver exit a parking lot at high speed; and respond to a report of two men trying to extricate their truck from a small ravine.
A deputy comes upon a robbery in progress; a woman mistakenly gives an officer a marijuana cigarette along with her ID; a lieutenant sorts out a dispute between twin sisters.

eps.d: Kansas City officers respond to a shooting; an estranged husband's claim of assault; and a disturbance in a parking lot. Also: a vehicle pursuit on winding streets.
Officers deal with a man threatening to kill himself with a shotgun; and discover a shooting victim inside a suspicious vehicle. Also: cops respond to a 911 hang-up call and find a domestic dispute.
Atlanta officers target suspected prostitutes; and patrol spring-break activities. Also: the pursuit of a suspect alleged to have committed several traffic violations.

Officers pursue an allegedly stolen vehicle; chase a driver thought to be avoiding a police roadblock; and question a burglary suspect who claims he entered a vacant dwelling to protect its contents from intruders.

A drug raid yields a large quantity of pot. A stabbing suspect is found injured after mistakenly leaping off a bridge during his escape. A man is questioned after allegedly pointing a gun at a passerby
Atlanta officers chase a suspected drug dealer; investigate a home-invasion robbery; investigate a homeless man who's alleged to have broken into a car.
The pursuit of a suspect who flees after a routine traffic stop; officers arrest suspects riding in a stolen car; and question a man driving with a suspended license.
In Atlanta, a man flees from a traffic stop; two alleged transvestites are arrested for using a stolen credit card; a cross-dressing man is questioned.
Officers break up a fight between two women; handle a large snake on a scared woman's front porch; and investigate a domestic dispute.

Officers pursue a suspect who drives into a ditch; a suspicious vehicle is discovered with an undressed couple in the back seat; an off-duty cop with an alleged intruder in his mother's home requests assistance.

Officers arrest a woman who allegedly went on a destructive rampage; assist in a rescue of a swimmer who appears intoxicated; and arrest a man neighbors accused of threatening them with a loaded pistol.

Officers raid an apartment allegedly used for growing marijuana; a woman reports being injured while trying to stop a fight; a man claims a female attacked and bit him as he attempted to remove sausage from a refrigerator.
Motel frequented by alleged drug dealers is raided; security officer aided at a trailer park; traffic stop.
Drug dealer is questioned; dispute erupts between transients; car thief is caught sleeping in a stolen van; in Atlanta.
Suspect in carjacking apprehended; officer aids a mother and daughter whose vehicle erupted in flames; suspect in robbery chased.

Driver flees a routine traffic stop; police officer lectures prostitute and john on AIDS; crack bust; in Palm Beach, Florida.

A car collides with a van during a pursuit; police grapple with a baby alligator; officers question an alleged flasher.
Sting operation targets drug buyers; man enters a stranger's home and moves the furniture; landlord extorts sexual favors from a tenant; in Palm Beach.
High-speed chase; burglar suspect hides near the shed he broke into; vandal is discovered on a rooftop; in Atlanta.
Virginia police officers investigate a man who dials 911 repeatedly; drug paraphernalia discovered; domestic dispute.
Drug raid on a private home; pawn-shop burglary; woman tries to kill husband.
Domestic dispute; man claims he was assaulted at his ex-wife's home; hurricane warning; Virginia Beach.
Shoplifter in a wheelchair assaults clerk; trespasser on a mobile-home roof; suspect rants obscenities.
Fleeing suspect throws drugs on the ground; stolen-vehicle suspects; child calls 911 in Palm Beach, Fla.
Stolen car suspect is pursued; man tosses his sister's belongings into the street; woman attempts to steal a bicycle; in Arizona.
Stolen sports utility vehicle pursuit; domestic dispute ends in injuries; a suspect cannot spell his name; in Arizona.
Arizona authorities respond to a bicycle-patrol officer struck by a car; question a man claiming he was attacked by in-laws with baseball bats; investigate an alleged theft at a mini-mart.

In Arizona, a tour of the Maricopa County jail's tent city and details of its disciplinary programs. Also: an investigation of a head-on crash between two vehicles; a man suspected of firing a weapon during an argument.
Female officers infiltrate a prostitution ring armed with hidden cameras; stolen bologna sparks a domestic dispute.
Palm Beach, Fla., officers apprehend two suspected car thieves; and question a bar customer who claims he was shortchanged. Also: alleged marijuana is found on a man.
Disabled deputy pursues a suspect; officer urges a prostitute to straighten out her life; suspect solicits prostitutes.
From Arizona. A Deputy pursues a fleeing subject on foot, transients wander through traffic and a stolen vehicle is pursued.
Suspect flees with something in his mouth; produce thief; dog tracks a fleeing suspect; in Palm Beach.

In Arizona, an officer fires at two robbery suspects who nearly run him down; a man is arrested for throwing objects off a second-story balcony; a man claims his girlfriend is suicidal and has run off with a gun.

In Indianapolis, officers capture a fleeing drug suspect; investigate an accident in which a girl was struck by a pick-up truck while riding her bicycle; arrest a domestic-violence suspect who challenges officers while handcuffed.
Indianapolis officers target customers in a prostitution sting; respond to a violent domestic dispute; investigate an attempted robbery during which the victim used martial arts in defense.
Narcotics suspect flees; a woman drives her SUV into the wall of a building; gun-brandishing suspect has pot; in Indianapolis.
Indianapolis officers stop a speeder and find marijuana in the vehicle, assist two children locked out of their family's motel room on purpose, and try to trap a fleeing suspect in a driveway.

Indianapolis officers respond to a shoplifting call; use a K-9 to find a suspect hiding in brush; and answer an assault call made by animal-control authorities trying to take custody of the suspect's dog.
Indianapolis Police arrest Boston fugitive. Dispute on car sale with no reverse gear. Domestic disturbance Man beating woman in parking lot.
An officer pulls over a fugitive who faces new charges when authorities find paraphernalia. A snake wrangler is called in to recover someone's pet. Officers investigate a woman's indecent dancing.

Three separate vehicle pursuits in Fort Worth include a suspected stolen car with marijuana found inside; a pick-up driven through signals, stop signs and yards; a suspect who tosses a syringe filled with heroin.

In Fort Worth, a suspect nearly runs down some officers before smashing his vehicle into the side of a building; suspects hide pot in a Bible; a woman pleads not to be taken to jail despite 13 warrants for her arrest.
After some struggle officers make an arrest in a stolen car report. Officers investigate a domestic dispute involving best friends. Officers question a man leaving a known drug hotbed.

Fort Worth officers search for a suspect believed to be armed with a high-powered assault rifle; answer a domestic-dispute call; arrest a profane woman who slips out of her handcuffs while in the rear of a patrol car.

Indianapolis officers assist a teenage overdose victim; draw their weapons at a robbery in progress; raid a trailer where alleged drug dealers reside; find a stash of cocaine with help from a suspect's girlfriend.
Indianapolis officers investigate a car accident, chase a suspect who leaves marijuana in his vehicle and arrest a foul-mouthed suspect accused of harassing a woman.

Fort Worth officers arrest two female car-theft suspects; respond to a woman's claim that she was ripped off in a drug deal; find marijuana during a routine traffic stop when one companion turns in another.
In Indianapolis, a man shot in the chest refuses to sit still; a fight among kids spreads to their parents; and a 7-year-old locks his mom out of their house and taunts officers.

Indianapolis officers chase a motorcyclist driving recklessly; arrest suspected prostitution "johns"; question an inebriated man alleged to have left a toddler unattended; intervene in a domestic dispute, where a female suspect allegedly assaults an officer.
Fort Worth officers stop a driver who admits he's looking for heroin; use a high-tech helicopter to search for two suspects; respond to a domestic dispute involving a mother and two sons.

Fort Worth officers question a couple leaving a house known for drug activity, chase a man who suddenly runs from a known drug area, stop a previous narcotics arrestee and find his pants stuffed with plastic baggies.
Albuquerque officers question a man with a stab wound; mediate between two women who are arguing; and respond to a robbery victim who claims another officer ignored him.

An Albuquerque officer performs a dangerous maneuver trying to stop an armed-robbery suspect. Also: officers find a bloodied teenager at a domestic call; and counsel a despondent woman who's recently lost her husband.

Fort Worth officers assist on a stakeout of two burglary suspects, and happen upon a possible drug deal in progress, witnessing suspects tossing suspicious items. They also question a man who claims self-defense in an attack by his mother's elderly husband.

Albuquerque, NM - Deputy Leonard Armijo chases a car with occupants that shot at a police. Officer Gary Barboa visits an emotionally distraught woman who called 911. Officer Gary Barboa responds to a disturbance at a motel where they find a man being held down and tied up.

Fort Worth officers encounter a trio suspected of using a gun to steal a truck; stop a van in an area known for prostitution; and find a couple engaged in intimacy in a car, with a toddler in the vehicle.

In Fort Worth, a helicopter joins the pursuit of two car-theft suspects; a domestic-violence victim refuses to press charges; an alleged prostitute is questioned and admits to having smoked crack earlier in the day.
Fort Worth officers pursue a suspect who bailed out of his car when motioned to stop; counsel a mother with a runaway teen; and stop a driver with no ID for the second time in three days.
In Fort Worth; driver owes thousands in tickets; father and son fight older man; marijuana found in cereal box.
